title: Chapter 315 The Legendary One-Second Man
content:
Chapter 315 The Legendary One-Second Man

Although Zhong Yu was injured and his physical strength was limited, making it difficult for him to exert one or two ten-thousandths of his normal strength, his eyesight and perception still existed.

For example, he felt an extremely evil aura at the gate of the small village below the mountain.

An extremely strong smell of blood emanated from this aura, as well as that evil aura, and an aura that was different from human beings, which seemed to be cold and gloomy.

Zhong Yu had a vague guess in his heart, this should be the so-called demon, that is, the evil god in the population of the island country.

But looking at this breath, although it is evil, it is not strong.

If you really want to compare, it is probably equivalent to the strength of the first order.

But this monster is in the first order, and its strength should belong to the top group. Coupled with the fact that monsters are generally rough-skinned, thick-skinned and powerful, it may take a lot of effort for ordinary second-orders to deal with this monster.

And based on the strength of the small village under the mountain observed by Zhong Yu, the strength of the three leading warriors is only at the first level, and their own blood is not very strong, so they should belong to the bottom of the first level.

Although they were not without a fight against that monster, they were still at a disadvantage overall. If they really fought against each other, they probably would hang.

Sure enough, with the passage of time, the three warriors seemed to communicate with the monster at the gate of the village, but the communication between the two parties did not seem to meet their respective purposes.

Soon, the samurai and the demon confronted each other, and the samurai even pulled out the samurai sword at his waist. The white blade pointed directly at the demon, shining brightly under the sunlight.

The monster on the opposite side also roared a few times and waved its thick arms a few times. The nails on its fingers were like sharp blades, a full ten centimeters long.

Ultimately, the standoff didn't last long.

Monsters are impatient after all, even if they have a little wisdom, they are not healthy after all, and it is more of the desire in their hearts that controls him.

roared.

The demon patted his chest, paused at the corner of his mouth, and rushed towards the leading warrior in front of him.

The air in front of the samurai was buzzing, and following the impact of the monster, the samurai felt an extremely frightening force coming over his face, making his hands and feet stiff, making it difficult to move.

But to become a warrior and lead a village of dozens of people, he would never lack the courage to fight.

The samurai quickly calmed down the fear in his heart, and tightly grasped the handle of the samurai sword in his hand with both hands.

Several layers of cloth were tightly wrapped around the hilt of the knife, soaked in sweat, which made the samurai's grip on the hilt more stable.

ha!

The samurai let out a sharp shout, and then seemed to have infinite courage in his heart, and there was an inexhaustible strength in his whole body.

The figure was violent, and the samurai dodged the monster's attack from the side. With a dexterous swipe of the katana in his hand, he attacked the weak point under the monster's ribs.

Although the monster's huge stature endowed it with extremely terrifying power, it also deprived him of his dexterity. Seeing the original target dodging, he left in front of him at an incredible speed and killed himself.

Caught off guard, the monster only had time to move its body a little bit, opening its weak point under the ribs a little, and the samurai sword swiped across the waist of the monster with a puff, bringing out a burst of blood.

The demon screamed and wailed.

The slap just now was ruthless. Although the injury was nothing compared to its huge body, the pain it caused was unavoidable.

"Okay, as expected of Lord Hetian. With this level of force, it seems that this mere monster is destined to be here today, and Lord Hetian will also become a hero who slaughters gods and demons."

"Of course, that is the supernatural power displayed by Mr. Wada just now. It is his famous stunt that cuts across the board. It is said that under this move, Mr. Wada has already beheaded three enemies. My lord has made a lot of contributions. This is why I got the reward from our village and became a warrior with a territory."

"It seems that this monster is destined to be unlucky. With his weak strength, he dared to invade our village."

Behind this samurai named Hotan, the dozens of men who were following him, saw him displaying supernatural power, and wounded this ferocious and mighty monster in one fell swoop.

They congratulated one after another, and couldn't help but feel even more fear and admiration for Lord Hetian's force. At the same time, the restless heart also calmed down.

The samurai in front of him was quite complacent about his attack, and when he heard the discussion of the crowd behind him, his face became even more radiant.

Looking at the howling monster in front of him, he couldn't help but show contempt, and the tense and serious expression of the whole person couldn't help but relax.

At the same time, he became ashamed and extremely annoyed by the fear that just surged out of his heart.

Looking at this monster, he couldn't help being complacent, and his eyes became more fierce, revealing traces of murderous intent, which was actually the idea of avenging his shame.

However, they don't know. The monster suffered only some minor flesh injuries, which did not hinder the overall strength of the monster.

On the contrary, because of being injured and seeing the blood, the monster will become more berserk, and its strength will skyrocket by several percent.

Facing the soaring demons, the warriors in front of them were determined not to be able to resist them.

Seeing his so-called one-size-fits-all just now, it was just a superficial movement skill.

In the eyes of those who have a little bit of background inheritance, even Ye Luzi's background, but are very talented in fighting, it is just a vulnerable mountain villager's style.

It's not even a move, it's just a little bit of skill that I've learned from using the samurai sword for a long time.

If you really face them, you can't even count as an enemy.

Sure enough, the demon in front of him wailed a few times, his eyes were red and bloodshot all over his eyeballs, and his muscles became more tense. Suddenly, it seemed to be a little swollen, but this was because of the vague Some illusions caused by the skyrocketing strength of the demon.

At the same time, the monster's bloody mouth opened further, and there were bursts of beast screams from inside. The whole monster looked more ferocious, like a monstrous ancient giant beast.

Then the monster jumped forward, not as slow as before, but quite fast.

With such a sudden attack, the samurai who had already relaxed in front of him had no time to react.

With a bang, the samurai's chest was hit by the monster's huge and thick palm.

There were a few clicks, and there seemed to be the sound of bones breaking in the warrior's chest, and at the same time, his chest was sunken, sinking into the body for a full one or two centimeters.

The samurai also spat out a mouthful of blood with a puff, mixed with rotten internal organs, and flew back more than ten meters. Only then did he fall heavily to the ground, causing the surrounding meters to tremble.

The samurai's eyes turned white, white foam was spit out from the corner of his mouth, mixed with blood, a pool of blood flowed out from his chest, and his whole body twitched slightly.

Not long after, there was no more movement, and the whole person was dead.
